The '''Endor Splendor Inn''' was an inn located on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Guest rooms were in 400 bungalows, and amenities included the [[Thatch Club Cabaret]], the [[Golden Magic Tavern]], the [[Village Drums Boutique]], and native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] guides. The inn was advertised at the [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
This inn and its amenities were advertised on a video screen exclusively seen in the queue of the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=bTHFWK8G_7A|text=TDL : Star Tours Queue Line No. 1|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
